info.title: Overlord: Ple Ple Pleiades 2
info.synopsis: Ainz pensa che la crisi con Shalltear sia risolta, ma all'improvviso viene teletrasportato trovandosi in un'azienda.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: As Ainz reaches out an supporting hand from Albedo, consoling him on his failure in preventing Shalltear's brainwashing, he immediately finds himself at the desk in an office space where all the NPCs are busy working, manning desks like a corporate facility. Ainz realizes that he in now the president of a company called Nazarick where all his employees are the NPCs from the Great Tomb of Nazarick.
